videos.title: Get Along Little Zombie
videos.overview:
After Dexter reveals himself as Gorog, the angel of darkness, he turns Felix evil in order to use his powerful wand to take over the Wizard World. Alex, Justin and Max learn from Professor Crumbs that they must use their wizard powers together to defeat Gorog and the dark side. 

Note: This is part 4 of a 4-part arc.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: The Russo family comes together to create the scariest haunted house ever for Halloween.
